name: dv
description: David Villavicencio's personal Claude Code skill suite. dv:pickup and dv:handoff bracket a session (hydrate context at the start, serialize state at the end); dv:review-claudemd keeps CLAUDE.md honest by mining conversation history; dv:tmux-window-namer styles tmux windows with a glyph, title, and palette; dv:reddit and dv:twitter fetch and summarize Reddit threads / X posts via public APIs (no auth); dv:critique stress-tests a plan with three parallel critique subagents; dv:cite enforces a re-fetch-or-decline freshness contract on realtime-fact queries; dv:mnemosyne-ops enables, health-checks, and maintains the Mnemosyne memory provider on a Hermes profile (gated enable, drift checks for carried patches and leaked system turns); dv:orca-setup writes, tests, and ships an Orca worktree setup script (orca.yaml) that leaves state other checkouts depend on untouched; dv:manager-mode switches a session into Manager Mode, where it plans, briefs and checks while hired agents on named model tiers (or procedures run by them) do the engineering (`off` switches it back); dv:ticket files a Linear ticket in the agreed format from a rough request and writes to Linear only after confirmation; dv:groom grooms an existing one (verification, neighbors, size, split, scouting for spin-offs, an interview on open decisions) and edits it only after approval, without starting the work; dv:closeout closes out a finished worktree session: it verifies the ticket, the PRs and what the worktree still holds, writes a note for the parent session in the main checkout, says whether the worktree is safe to delete, and archives the session's handoff when it is.
